_doc: harness-sync manifest (committed base — PORTABLE values only). Machine-specific overrides go in harnesses.local.json (gitignored; template: harnesses.local.json.example). harness-sync.sh deep-merges local over this base. Env vars beat both where noted.

claude._doc: The .claude/ layer is rendered by deploy.sh (skills symlinks + GENERATED agents, stamped model: from agent_models); harness-sync invokes it for app targets and mirrors FROM it for the other harnesses. agent_models resolves the tier: field every agents/*.md carries; orchestrator is the harness-default model (user interaction), never a subagent assignment.

codex._doc: Skills via the vendor-neutral .agents/skills path (also read by Pi). Agent TOMLs are GENERATED, not symlinked — Codex does not follow symlinked agent TOMLs (openai/codex#15345). Never touch config.toml [hooks.state] trusted_hash entries.

droid._doc: No FACTORY_HOME env override exists — ~/.factory is wired via symlinks into the tracked tools/droid/ dir (setup.sh pattern). App-level .factory/ dirs are projected directly.

pi._doc: Pi reads .agents/skills up the cwd tree (covered by the codex mirror) + <home>/skills globally. No declarative agents/hooks/MCP surfaces — those are skipped with a warning, never silently.

grok._doc: Grok Build (xAI). Machine scope only: hooks -> <home>/hooks/00-ac.json (trauma-guard + activity-logger — the only hooks that function; Grok discards passive-event stdout, verified 2026-07-12 on v0.2.93) and context -> <home>/AGENTS.md (generated global rules — loaded in every Grok session). Skills arrive via the .agents/skills compat mirror; no org/app hook layers (context hooks can't function there, and machine scope avoids per-repo folder-trust ceremony). REQUIRED one-time machine setup in <home>/config.toml: [compat.claude] hooks = false (prevents double-fire via Claude-compat hook scanning; skills/rules/mcps compat stays on) + [mcp_servers.qmd] (memory pull layer).

opencode._doc: opencode (Anomaly, ex-SST) — the vendor-independent cold-standby / harness-failover tier (distinct from claude-or = model-failover, pi = local utility). Runs OpenCode Go open models (orchestrator default glm-5.3; coordinator/worker stances on deepseek-v4-flash; validator stance-override glm-5.3-flash — 2026-09-07: a quality gate never runs on the same weights that built what it gates; stance overrides resolve first, tier default second, both fail loud); Go's single curated endpoint avoids OpenRouter's per-provider cache-passthrough lottery, measured 2026-07-28: DeepSeek via OpenRouter returned zero cached tokens vs 98% native). OPENROUTER_API_KEY/Go key auto-detected, no login. Machine scope only (no org/app layer): context -> <home>/AGENTS.md (generated session-start floor). Skills read NATIVELY from .claude/skills/*/SKILL.md AND .agents/skills — deduped by name, so the Codex mirror costs nothing (re-verified 2026-08-28 on v1.18.20: 85 skills in body-compass-app, zero duplicates). Agents are GENERATED to <home>/agents/*.md (gen_opencode_agents, the 5 core stances only) — opencode reads neither .claude/agents nor any compat path. Hooks ARE wired as of 2026-08-28 (was "skipped by design v1"): render_hooks_opencode emits <home>/plugins/ac-hooks.js + <home>/ac-hooks.wiring.json, a wrapper that runs the SAME scripts as every other harness (UserPromptSubmit via chat.message part injection, PreToolUse via tool.execute.before throw, PostToolUse via tool.execute.after). No SessionStart or SubagentStop equivalent exists. REQUIRED one-time machine setup: <home>/opencode.jsonc (model defaults + qmd and mcp-agent-mail MCP, hand-authored — mirrors grok's config.toml). COST: opencode has NO skillListingBudgetFraction analogue — the full <available_skills> block goes into the system prompt every request (measured 42KB of a 74.5KB system prompt for 56 skills), which is why this is a fallback tier, not a peer. GOTCHA: hangs at the ~/Repos monorepo root (huge submodule tree chokes its file walk) — run inside a project subdir, which is the real coding-fallback use case anyway. Homebrew lags npm (brew 1.18.20 vs npm 1.18.25 on 2026-08-28).

antigravity._doc: Google Antigravity (com.google.antigravity, v2.2.1+) — the Gemini-CLI successor; replaced it on 2026-08-31 (the CLI was decommissioned 2026-07-04). Customization model reverse-engineered from Contents/Resources/bin/language_server, NOT from docs — re-verify after each app update. TWO customization roots: WORKSPACE = '.agents' relative to the workspace root (the SAME vendor-neutral path Codex+Pi already use, so skills and rules cost nothing extra), GLOBAL = <home> (= the app data dir under GeminiDir=~/.gemini; this is where Antigravity itself planted mcp_config.json). Both roots auto-discover 'skills/<name>/' with no registration (skills.json is only for out-of-root paths) and read 'AGENTS.md' for rules. NOTE ~/.gemini is SHARED STATE: it holds Antigravity's brain/, conversations/, knowledge/ and browser profile — never rm -rf it. MCP: <home>/mcp_config.json is Antigravity's own symlink to <config_dir>/mcp_config.json, so we render the canon into config_dir and leave the symlink alone. HOOKS (LOCATED + VERIFIED 2026-09-07, ac-antigravity-close-hook-loop-j6xw): hooks.json lives in a CUSTOMIZATION ROOT — globally ~/.gemini/config/hooks.json (config_dir), or <workspace>/.agents/hooks.json per project. Format: each top-level key is a hook NAME mapping to per-EVENT arrays; PreToolUse/PostToolUse are GROUPED ({matcher: regex over the AGENT's tool name — snake_case like run_command/view_file/browser_*, never Claude's Bash/Edit; "*" or "" matches all), PreInvocation/PostInvocation/Stop are FLAT handler lists ({type: command, command, timeout}); enabled: false disables; ~ expands; cwd = the hooks.json directory; payload is camelCase protojson on stdin (a Claude-shaped tool_input guard fails open — payload translation is a guard-compat follow-up). Empirically confirmed: the app's hooks manager logged 'loaded 1 named hooks from 1 hooks.json file(s)' (hooks_manager.go) on the next CLI session after this exact shape was written to ~/.gemini/config/hooks.json. The load fires at SESSION start (a conversation), never at server boot — verify with `harness-sync.sh --verify-antigravity`, which scans ~/Library/Logs/Antigravity, the App Support session logs, and ~/.gemini/antigravity-cli/cli.log. SUBAGENTS: DERIVED FACT — no on-disk subagent-definition format exists in this build: the customization system defines rules/skills/plugins/hooks/mcp only, agent scripts are runtime-saved (SaveAgentScriptCommandSpec), agents.json/agent.json are registration manifests, and markdown agents are gated behind the enable-markdown-agents experiment. Nothing to render; stated in gen_antigravity_agents, never skipped silently. CONTEXT: no session-start or pre-prompt hook event was found, so context travels statically via the generated global AGENTS.md, exactly like grok.
